description: Trim the vestigial node-era options param shape from the SpawnFn seam type in the check:all gate-runner.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Bun.spawnSync's OptionsObject has no `encoding` key and configures streams via `stdin`/`stdout`/`stderr` (or a `stdio` tuple), never a scalar `stdio: 'inherit'|'pipe'` string or `encoding: 'utf8'`. Confirms the node-era `{ encoding: 'utf8'; stdio?: 'inherit'|'pipe' }` shape on the SpawnFn seam is fully vestigial: the default impl hardcodes per-stream inherit and never reads the options arg.

userStories.title: Trim vestigial node-era options param from the SpawnFn seam type
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the SpawnFn seam type in scripts/check-all.ts to declare only what the Bun.spawnSync-based seam actually consumes, so that the vestigial node-era `{ encoding: 'utf8'; stdio?: 'inherit' | 'pipe' }` shape (dead surface left by the CAM-308 node->Bun.spawnSync migration) stops misleading readers into thinking the runner passes encoding/stdio options.
acceptanceCriteria: The SpawnFn type in scripts/check-all.ts no longer declares the node-era options shape: `grep` for the literal `stdio?: 'inherit' | 'pipe'` returns no match. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -q "stdio?: 'inherit' | 'pipe'" scripts/check-all.ts]

The `encoding: 'utf8'` argument no longer appears in scripts/check-all.ts (neither in the SpawnFn type nor at the runGates call site). [oracle: file-assert ! grep -q "encoding: 'utf8'" scripts/check-all.ts]

The default SpawnFn impl behavior is unchanged: the fallback still calls Bun.spawnSync with per-stream inherit (stdin/stdout/stderr all 'inherit'). [oracle: file-assert grep -q "stdin: 'inherit', stdout: 'inherit', stderr: 'inherit'" scripts/check-all.ts]
All SpawnFn call sites and test fakes in test/check-all.test.ts still typecheck against the trimmed signature. [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
The full quality spine is green (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: scripts/check-all.ts (SpawnFn type at ~line 34-38; runGates default impl at ~line 133-134; call site `spawnFn(gate.cmd, gate.args, { encoding: 'utf8' })` at ~line 141), test/check-all.test.ts (SpawnFn fakes at ~line 51-54 `(cmd, args, _opts) => ...` and ~line 218 `() => signalTerminated`). Simplest correct trim: drop the third `options` param from the SpawnFn type entirely (the default impl at line 134 already ignores it and hardcodes cwd + per-stream inherit; the sole call site only passes it to satisfy the type). Then remove the `{ encoding: 'utf8' }` third argument at the runGates call site, and drop the now-unused `_opts` param from the test fake at line 54 so the 3-param fake matches the trimmed 2-param type (noUncheckedIndexedAccess strict: a 3-param impl is NOT assignable to a 2-param function type). Keep the return type `SyncSubprocess<'inherit','inherit'>` unchanged. This is pure dead-surface cleanup from the CAM-308 migration (Source: cam/issue-308); no functional change. scripts/ is not vendor/ or templates/, so no embed-vendor drift check applies. Verify the runGates default fallback still spawns with stdin/stdout/stderr 'inherit' after the edit.
